incident.description: API Gateway Lambda hitting 512MB memory limit
incident.errorLogs:
[ERROR] 2025-01-15T14:32:15Z - Max Memory Used: 511 MB
[CRITICAL] Error rate 73.2%

auditor_result.root_cause: Lambda function OOM due to unbounded in-memory cache growth
reasoning_chain: Log pattern shows Max Memory Used == Memory Size (511/512 MB)
Runtime killed signal indicates OOM not timeout
Error rate 73.2% with 847 failed requests in 60s confirms widespread impact
